The '''''Corsa-Vinn''''' was a [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] [[720 light freighter/Legends|720 light freighter]] owned and operated by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] and honest free-trader [[Grumme Vinn]].

==History==
The ''Corsa-Vinn'' was owned by several generations of [[Grumme Vinn]]'s family, including his parents, many of whom operated the ship as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] vessel. Grumme, who ran away from his parents once he learned of their smuggling profession, inherited the ''Corsa-Vinn'' at a point when it had become old and dilapidated. With no pride in his heritage, Grumme established a legal cargo transportation business, and flew his [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] along the backwater [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Typically Grumme would use the ''Corsa-Vinn'' to haul supplies to settlements, take on passengers, or run specialty cargo for picky clients. On several occasions crooked drop point agents attempted to con Vinn into hauling hidden contraband, but the spacer's moral code remained intact.<ref name="PSG" />
